A '''Jedi Candidate''' was a prospective [[Force-sensitive/Legends|force-sensitive]] who was to be considered for [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] under the [[New Jedi Order]] but were not allowed become a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] for one of several reasons.

[[Dyon Stadd]] was one example, as he was unable to become a Jedi because his [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Force power/Legends|powers]] were not sufficiently strong.
